messages:
morgan: quick ask — we need a short-lived "break-glass" allow in the service CIDR to let vendor healthchecks reach our internal /health endpoint. They hit from 34.120.66.12 and 34.120.66.13 over TCP/443. request: add these IPs to the ALLOW list for svc-alpha in prod for a 2 hour window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. will be applied via terraform PR (link below).

priya: can you paste the minimal terraform diff you plan to apply? also we need an entry in the audit log and a redaction check on the health logs so no user identifiers are emitted during the window.

morgan: sure — PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/terraform/+/9876 — snippet:```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "svc_alpha_vendor_health" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["34.120.66.12/32", "34.120.66.13/32"]
  description = "temp vendor healthchecks - 2h window - ticket #INC-4551"
}
```

dave_netops: two quick things: 1) we prefer creating a time-limited network ACL rule so it doesn't linger accidentally (Terraform will still apply but ops will revoke with a runbook). 2) we'll gate it behind the change freeze calendar — is tomorrow within a freeze window?

morgan: not a freeze window, confirmed. I'll update the PR to include a terraform null_resource that tags the change with expiry metadata and add a runbook step for manual revoke.

alex_sre: logging/redaction note — our side emits instance_id + request_id + status only for /health. confirm: vendor healthchecks won't include any user tokens. we should add a transient filter at the load balancer to strip any query params and drop any X-User-* headers. I can push a listener rule for the 2h window if security signs off.

lina_prod: product okay with temporary allow as long as rollback is automatic. please ensure we have an ops owner and an escalation contact.

morgan: ops owner = @dave_netops, escalation = me and @alex_sre. Rollback plan in PR description (automated revoke at 11:05 UTC via scheduled CI job + manual runbook).

priya: Security review checklist from me: 1) confirm IPs are only those two 2) minimal ports (443 only) 3) runbook + owner 4) ensure LB strip/filter 5) log retention & redaction — how long do we keep the health logs?

security-bot: ACL change request created: INC-4551. Please add evidence (PR link, runbook) and mark 'security-reviewed' once done.

dave_netops: I'll implement the time-limited NACL and the scheduled CI revoke. also will add the LB rule to strip query params. I need explicit "security-reviewed" in the PR before I deploy.

morgan: updated PR with NACL + scheduled revoke + runbook. asked @priya to review redaction config and @alex_sre to add the LB listener patch.

priya: quick review complete — redaction filter added and the health logs are routed to a short-retention (7d) bucket and a separate metrics-only pipeline (no traces). marked the PR with "security-reviewed".

alex_sre: LB listener patch pushed to the same PR, CI pipeline green. I will be standing by during the window to monitor latency/error spikes.

lina_prod: thanks all. product approves; make sure post-mortem is filed if anything unexpected happens. :thumbsup:

morgan: great — scheduling the deploy for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. tagging this thread when the change is live and when it's revoked.

security-bot: INC-4551 -> status: security-approved.
